snapshot.cross_check: $1.0783 last trade on Kraken, 3:28 AM MST (Kraken 24h range $1.0750 to $1.1157)

confirmed: XRP is about $1.08 early Tuesday, down about 0.8% over 24 hours, about 15.4% lower than 7 days ago and about 23% below 30 days ago (CoinGecko snapshot, 3:28 AM MST; Kraken last trade $1.0783, 24h range $1.0750 to $1.1157). Monday's low near $1.075 was the weakest in 60 daily sessions, and its daily RSI momentum gauge is near 26, in what analysts call oversold territory, which does not by itself signal a bottom (The Crypto Basic, FXStreet). About $26M of XRP long positions were liquidated on Nov 9 (The Coin Republic). No Ripple- or XRP Ledger-specific news was behind the move.

Monday was mixed across markets: US stocks rallied (Nasdaq +2.75%, S&P 500 +2.35%) while crypto lagged, with bitcoin ending the UTC day near $75,250 after a $73,667 low, and ether and XRP down closer to 4% to 5% (CoinDesk, Basis Desk). The Sunday-night flush liquidated more than $1 billion in leveraged crypto positions, mostly longs (CoinGlass via CoinDesk). Reuters tied the weakness to worries that a Democratic-controlled Congress will toughen crypto rules and to the Binance heist; neither is XRP-specific.

US spot XRP ETFs had net outflows of about $10.4M on Mon Nov 9, the largest daily outflow in about eight months, after four flat days; Bitwise's XRP fund lost about $9.4M, Canary's XRPC about $811K and 21Shares' TOXR about $213K (SoSoValue via ChainCatcher, TokenPost, FXStreet). Cumulative net inflows are about $1.80B and total net assets fell to about $1.24B.

On the XRP Ledger, the proposed native LendingProtocol amendment rose to 22 of 35 trusted-validator votes by Nov 10 (XRPScan, XRPLHub), up from 21; it needs 29, held for two weeks, to activate, and SingleAssetVault has 23. Neither is live and no activation date exists. The fixCleanup3_4_0 security amendment has been live since Nov 4. Separately, the XRPL Foundation's 2027 roadmap (updated Nov 4) includes a draft design for quantum-resistant account keys at no extra fee; it is not live, owners would have to switch keys themselves, and Ripple's target for a full transition is 2028 (CoinDesk, Ripple).

Binance is targeting Fri Nov 13 to reopen withdrawals for its last six paused tokens (HYPE, INJ, APT, PLASMA, NEAR, LTC) and all tokens on already-restored networks; no exact day or hour has been given (Binance Recovery Update #9 via MABOnChain, The Coin Republic). XRP withdrawals on the XRP Ledger reopened Nov 3 and XRP on Ethereum on Nov 6. Binance says about 98% of hacked assets are replenished, and the zero-knowledge proof for its Nov 4 Proof of Reserves snapshot is ready for user verification. Separately, Binance confirmed it will close affected European accounts by Dec 31 after the EU's MiCA transition period expired without it obtaining authorization; deposits are blocked for those accounts but withdrawals remain open (Investing.com, Nov 8).

The US added 165,000 jobs in October, far above the roughly 59,000 to 65,000 economists expected, and unemployment fell to 4.1% from 4.2%; September was revised up to 60,000 (BLS via CoinDesk, Bitcoin Magazine). Bitcoin barely moved on the release, holding near $75,500 to $75,800, but rate-hike odds for the Fed's Dec 9 meeting rose to about 79% (CME FedWatch via Bitcoin Magazine). Thursday's tech-stock sell-off had already pushed crypto lower.

BNY now supports XRP and RLUSD custody: Ripple and BNY announced Oct 27 that BNY's Digital Asset Custody platform now supports XRP and RLUSD for institutional clients. Plans to let BNY clients mint and redeem RLUSD directly, and a tokenized trade finance pilot with C2FO on the XRP Ledger, are still subject to approvals (The Block, Cointelegraph).

Ripple's November escrow cycle is complete: 1 billion XRP was released at 00:00 UTC Nov 1, and Ripple re-locked 700 million XRP in three new escrows that open in June and July 2029, leaving 300 million XRP outside escrow, the same pattern as September and October (TokenPost, Coinpaper, Whale Alert). That does not show the 300 million were sold.
not_confirmed: The CLARITY Act has not passed the Senate: the 'Senate Banking Committee advances CLARITY Act 15 to 9' posts recycle a May 14, 2026 vote, and the full Senate then failed to advance it 49 to 50 on Sept 15. 'Trump signs crypto bill' posts are false. 'U.S. has signed a bill to replace FedNow with a next-generation payment system powered by XRP' and 'RealToken on XRP Ledger will unlock $650 trillion on Nov 14' posts are false; no such law or unlock exists. '$28,000 per XRP' price predictions and 'if you hold 500+ XRP you might already be a millionaire' posts are speculation with no source. 'Convert your funds into XRP as banks go cashless' and 'get money out of the bank / financial reset' posts are engagement bait with no official basis. 'Whales now control nearly 74% of supply' does not match the latest Santiment figure of about 68.5% for 10M+ XRP wallets. BlackRock's appearance at Swell is a digital-assets director on an asset-manager panel, not a BlackRock XRP deal. No outlet confirms the '$60 billion' or '$73 billion in XRP transfers overnight' posts or the 'Trump met with Ripple' posts. 'XRP hit $37,000 on Bybit' posts have no evidence; XRP trades near $1.20 on every major venue. 'The Fed is being told to stand down as XRP gets the green light' has no basis. 'Reset is live' countdowns, 'QFS card' help desks, airdrops and move-your-coins or message-me-for-a-guide offers fit common scam patterns. 'North Korea's $6.3 billion XRP heist' posts are wrong: the $6.3B was taken from Binance hot wallets across many networks and assets, not XRP alone. 'XRP shorts on Bitfinex surge 652.89% to 468.2 MILLION' does not match Bitfinex's public margin data. 'Central banks agreed on a $5,000 set price for XRP' has no source. 'Explosive Goldman Sachs connection to XRP' is a teaser for a video with no document. 'Bloomberg spotlights XRP in 10 early races' misreads a Bloomberg election headline about House districts. 'Garlinghouse confirmed Ripple will become a major SWIFT shareholder by Nov 24' has no source. '$196.88 per XRP within days' posts label themselves rumors and give no basis. 'Bank of America announces an official large-scale partnership with Ripple' posts are false: neither company has announced one; BofA's documented link is as a connected bank in Ripple Treasury's (GTreasury) software gateway, not an XRP deal. 'Warren says the CLARITY Act will blow up the economy' recycles a May 2026 committee-hearing quote, not new news. 'Trump XRP payment claims, Nov 22' has no source. 'A $60 trillion bank just said which one it wants, XRP or XLM' is a video teaser with no named bank or document. 'Trump has signed an order opening 401(k)s to crypto' posts this weekend are not new: no new order was signed; the pending step is the Labor Department's final 401(k) alternatives rule, under White House review since Nov 5. '99.5% chance of XRP at $3,300 per coin, insane SEC filing' is a video teaser that names no filing. 'Frustrated XRP investors threatening to sell everything once they break even' is commentary, not data. 'Nearly $83 billion in XRP transfers recorded overnight' posts name no source or on-chain tracker, and follow the same template as earlier '$60 billion' and '$73 billion' posts. 'CNBC calls XRP the hottest crypto trade of the year' clips recycle a Jan 6, 2026 CNBC Power Lunch segment, when XRP was near $2.40. 'Kevin Warsh officially sworn in as Fed Chair' is old news: he took office May 22, 2026. 'Fed XRP settlement testing' and '20% XRP burn' claims have no source. 'Former Ripple employee says this is where millionaires are made' names no one. 'ETF clients buy $3 million of XRP, bringing ETF net assets to $1.43 billion' is contradicted: XRP ETFs had about $10.4M of outflows on Nov 9 and net assets near $1.24B. 'XRP Ledger introduces quantum-proof accounts' overstates a draft roadmap design that is not live. 'Senator Van Hollen will not vote for the CLARITY Act' is not new: he opposed it in May and voted no on Sept 15. 'Former Goldman Sachs analyst warns $0.30 is next' names no one. 'A newly activated wallet received $167.7 million of XRP' gives no transaction or source. Details are in the rumors section.

news.headline: XRP ETFs record largest daily outflow in eight months
news.summary: US spot XRP ETFs saw about $10.42M of net outflows on Nov 9, led by Bitwise's XRP fund (about $9.40M); cumulative net inflows about $1.798B, net assets about $1.238B.

news.headline: XRP Ledger's quantum plan needs owners to switch off old wallet keys
news.summary: A draft design in the XRPL Foundation's 2027 roadmap would let owners add a quantum-resistant ML-DSA-44 key and disable the old one, with no extra fee. Still in development; not live. Ripple targets a full transition by 2028.

news.headline: XRP RSI falls below 30 as the $1.07 area holds
news.summary: XRP closed Monday at about $1.0976 after a $1.075 low, the weakest in 60 sessions; daily RSI about 26.7. Oversold momentum is confirmed, a reversal is not.

news.headline: XRP price falls toward $1.10 as long liquidations exceed $40M
news.summary: About $26M of XRP liquidations on Nov 9, 98% longs; an analyst (Darkfost) reports about 691M XRP of whale inflows to Binance in one day, the largest since 2024. Analyst levels are opinion.

news.headline: Crypto prices give ground even as stocks and gold surge
news.summary: Nasdaq rose 2.75% and the S&P 500 2.35% on Monday while bitcoin slipped about 1% and ether and XRP fell closer to 5%.

news.headline: Cryptocurrencies slide to two-month lows after US midterms
news.summary: Bitcoin and ether touched their lowest since August as investors weighed tougher regulation from a Democratic-controlled Congress and the Binance heist.

news.headline: XRP price drops 12.5% in a week as over $1 billion in crypto is liquidated
news.summary: XRP fell to $1.09 on Nov 9 (CoinMarketCap); about $32.4M of XRP positions liquidated in 24 hours, 97% longs. The article says no single event is shown to have caused the decline.

news.headline: Bitcoin's drop and pop triggers $1 billion in liquidations
news.summary: BTC fell to about $73,761, its lowest since August, then rebounded above $75,000; $913M of the $1B+ liquidated were longs (CoinGlass). Nvidia CEO reports and stalled US-Iran talks cited as weekend risk-off triggers.

news.headline: Binance to close affected European accounts by Dec 31
news.summary: After the EU's MiCA transition period expired without authorization, Binance is closing affected accounts in France, Spain, Italy and Poland; deposits blocked, withdrawals still open, monthly fees on remaining balances from Nov 29.

news.headline: Garlinghouse: RLUSD competes with other stablecoins, not XRP
news.summary: Ripple's CEO said on X that RLUSD isn't competing with XRP. Evernorth says 92% of the $1.65B in RLUSD swapped on the XRPL DEX this year traded against XRP; analysts disagree on what that means for XRP demand.

news.headline: XRPL Foundation outlines 24 upgrades with up to $5.74M in estimated costs
news.summary: 2027 roadmap covering lending, perpetual futures, smart contracts and institutional tools. Only two upgrades are approved; 22 remain proposals.

news.headline: Binance targets Nov 13 to reopen withdrawals for six altcoins
news.summary: Recap of Recovery Update #9: HYPE, INJ, APT, PLASMA, NEAR and LTC targeted by the end of next week; each route still needs security checks. No exact day given.

news.headline: Binance Recovery Update #9: withdrawals reopen for 58 more network-token pairs
news.summary: From 04:00 UTC Nov 6 across nine networks, including XRP on Ethereum. Rolls out progressively; deposits stay open.

claims.claim: JUST IN: ETF clients buy $3 million worth of $XRP, bringing total ETF-held net assets to $1.43 billion.
claims.check: SoSoValue data show US spot XRP ETFs had about $10.4M of net outflows on Nov 9, not inflows, and total net assets of about $1.24B, not $1.43B. The $1.43B figure is close to where net assets stood in late October.
claims.check_title: ChainCatcher: XRP spot ETF net outflow of $10.42M on Nov 9

claims.claim: JUST IN: XRP Ledger introduces quantum-proof accounts for users. The network upgrade secures user wallets against future quantum threats with zero extra fees.
claims.who: @popmemecoin and several similar accounts on X, Nov 10
claims.check: Based on a real CoinDesk report, but overstated: it is a draft design in the XRPL Foundation's 2027 roadmap, not a live upgrade. Owners would have to add a new key and switch off the old one themselves; Ripple targets a full transition by 2028.
claims.check_title: CoinDesk: XRP Ledger's quantum plan needs owners to switch off old wallet keys

claims.claim: JUST IN AMERICANS DEMOCRAT SENATOR VAN HOLLEN JUST ANNOUNCED HE WILL NOT VOTE FOR THE $XRP CLARITY ACT
claims.check: Not new: Sen. Van Hollen issued a statement opposing the digital-assets bill on May 14, 2026 and voted no when the Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act 49 to 50 on Sept 15. The CLARITY Act is not an 'XRP' bill.
claims.check_title: Van Hollen statement on opposition to digital assets legislation (May 14, 2026)

claims.claim: JUST IN: Former Goldman Sachs analyst calls $XRP a "FALLING KNIFE" and warns that $0.30 could be next.
claims.check: Names no analyst and links no interview or report; no outlet carries it. A price call from an unnamed person is speculation either way.

claims.claim: JUST IN: A newly activated wallet just received $167,700,000 worth of $XRP. Wtf is happening???
claims.check: Gives no transaction, wallet address or tracker, and no outlet reports it. Large transfers between exchange or custody wallets are routine and say nothing about buying or selling on their own.

claims.claim: 🚨JUST IN: Nearly $83 BILLION in $XRP transfers recorded overnight. Wtf is going on???
claims.who: @Steph_iscrypto on X (about 14K views), Nov 9; copied by other accounts
claims.check: Names no source, transaction or on-chain tracker, and no outlet reports it. It follows the same template as earlier '$60 billion' and '$73 billion overnight' posts. For scale, XRP's whole market value is about $69B (CoinGecko).

claims.claim: 🚨 JUST IN: CNBC CALLS $XRP THE "HOTTEST" CRYPTO TRADE OF THE YEAR! "IT IS NOT BITCOIN. IT IS NOT ETHER. IT IS XRP."
claims.who: Several small accounts on X (e.g. @simple_crypto7), Nov 9
claims.check: Real quote, but recycled: CNBC Power Lunch host Brian Sullivan said it on Jan 6, 2026, when XRP was near $2.40 after a 25% January rally. It is not a new CNBC call; XRP is down about 22% over the past 30 days.
claims.check_title: CryptoPotato: CNBC crowns XRP hottest crypto trade of 2026 (January 2026)

claims.claim: JUST IN: 🇺🇸 Pro-crypto Kevin Warsh officially sworn in as Federal Reserve Chair, replacing Jerome Powell.
claims.who: @JakeClaver2xx on X, Nov 8; reposted by @jakexrp3, Nov 10
claims.check: True but not news: Warsh took the oath of office as Fed chair on May 22, 2026, according to the Federal Reserve. Posting it as 'just in' in November is misleading.
claims.check_title: Federal Reserve: Kevin Warsh takes oath of office as chairman (May 22, 2026)

claims.claim: JUST IN: Claims of Fed XRP settlement testing are circulating! Could this be a game-changer for $XRP? What about the rumored 20% burn?
claims.check: The post itself calls these 'claims' and 'rumored'. No Federal Reserve statement or mainstream report describes XRP settlement testing, and there is no XRP burn proposal from Ripple or the XRP Ledger.
